18.query:
fetch user.sessions, from: $dt_timeframe_from - $TimeShift*1d, to: $dt_timeframe_to
| fieldsAdd _frontend = arrayFirst(frontend.name)
| filter in(_frontend, $AppName)
| fieldsAdd period = if(timestamp >= $dt_timeframe_from, "current", else: "previous")
| summarize cur = countIf(period=="current"), prev = countIf(period=="previous")
| fieldsAdd delta = cur - prev
| fieldsAdd trend = if(delta > 0, if(true, "🟢", else: "🔴"), else: if(delta < 0, if(true, "🔴", else: "🟢"), else: "🟡"))
| fieldsAdd label = if(isNull(cur), "no data",
    else: concat(toString(round(cur, decimals:0)), "  (", if(delta>=0, "+", else: ""), toString(round(delta, decimals:0)), " ", trend, ")"))
| fields label

23.query:
fetch user.events, from: $dt_timeframe_from - $TimeShift*1d, to: $dt_timeframe_to
| filter in(frontend.name, $AppName)
| filter characteristics.classifier == "user_action"
| fieldsAdd period = if(start_time >= $dt_timeframe_from, "current", else: "previous")
| fieldsAdd _bucket = if(duration <= toDuration($ApdexThreshold * 1000000), "satisfied",
    else: if(duration <= toDuration($ApdexThreshold * 4 * 1000000), "tolerated", else: "frustrated"))
| summarize
    curSat = countIf(period=="current" and _bucket=="satisfied"), curTol = countIf(period=="current" and _bucket=="tolerated"), curTot = countIf(period=="current"),
    prevSat = countIf(period=="previous" and _bucket=="satisfied"), prevTol = countIf(period=="previous" and _bucket=="tolerated"), prevTot = countIf(period=="previous")
| fieldsAdd cur = round((curSat + curTol/2) / curTot, decimals:2), prev = round((prevSat + prevTol/2) / prevTot, decimals:2)
| fieldsAdd delta = round(cur - prev, decimals:2)
| fieldsAdd trend = if(delta > 0, "🟢", else: if(delta < 0, "🔴", else: "🟡"))
| fieldsAdd label = if(isNull(cur), "no data",
    else: concat(toString(cur), "  (", if(delta>=0, "+", else: ""), toString(delta), " ", trend, ")"))
| fields label

77.query:
fetch user.events, from: $dt_timeframe_from - 21*1d, to: $dt_timeframe_to
| filter in(frontend.name, $AppName)
| filter characteristics.classifier == "view_summary"
| fieldsAdd _daysAgo = (toLong($dt_timeframe_to) - toLong(start_time)) / (24*3600*1000000000)
| summarize
    Current = sum(if(_daysAgo <= (toLong($dt_timeframe_to) - toLong($dt_timeframe_from)) / (24*3600*1000000000), error.exception_count)),
    Shift7d = sum(if(_daysAgo > 7 and _daysAgo <= 8, error.exception_count)),
    Shift14d = sum(if(_daysAgo > 14 and _daysAgo <= 15, error.exception_count)),
    Shift21d = sum(if(_daysAgo > 21 and _daysAgo <= 22, error.exception_count)),
    by: {page.name}
| fieldsRename Page = page.name
| fieldsAdd Delta7d = Current - Shift7d, Delta14d = Current - Shift14d, Delta21d = Current - Shift21d
| filter Current > 0
| sort Current desc
| limit 50

86.query:
fetch user.events, from: $dt_timeframe_from - 21*1d, to: $dt_timeframe_to
| filter in(frontend.name, $AppName)
| filter characteristics.classifier == "user_action"
| fieldsAdd _daysAgo = (toLong($dt_timeframe_to) - toLong(start_time)) / (24*3600*1000000000)
| fieldsAdd _windowLen = (toLong($dt_timeframe_to) - toLong($dt_timeframe_from)) / (24*3600*1000000000)

    Current = round(toDouble(if($Aggregate == "Avg", avg(if(_daysAgo <= _windowLen, $KPI)), else: median(if(_daysAgo <= _windowLen, $KPI)))) / 1000000, decimals:0),
    Shift7d = round(toDouble(if($Aggregate == "Avg", avg(if(_daysAgo > 7 and _daysAgo <= 8, $KPI)), else: median(if(_daysAgo > 7 and _daysAgo <= 8, $KPI)))) / 1000000, decimals:0),
    Shift14d = round(toDouble(if($Aggregate == "Avg", avg(if(_daysAgo > 14 and _daysAgo <= 15, $KPI)), else: median(if(_daysAgo > 14 and _daysAgo <= 15, $KPI)))) / 1000000, decimals:0),
    Shift21d = round(toDouble(if($Aggregate == "Avg", avg(if(_daysAgo > 21 and _daysAgo <= 22, $KPI)), else: median(if(_daysAgo > 21 and _daysAgo <= 22, $KPI)))) / 1000000, decimals:0),
    by: {page.name}
| fieldsRename Page = page.name
| fieldsAdd Delta7d = Current - Shift7d, Delta14d = Current - Shift14d, Delta21d = Current - Shift21d
| filter isNotNull(Current)
| sort Current desc
| limit 50
